For any initial balances state and any collect amount, after a caller deposits and then collects an amount less than or equal to both their balance and MinSum, the caller's balance must decrease exactly by the collected amount; the bug fails to record the deposit, so the collect will revert or underflow when it tries to deduct from an unchanged zero balance.

For any actor that deposits funds via Deposit, a subsequent Collect call for an amount <= MinSum and <= balance must succeed and decrease the sender's balance, but the bug fails to credit the deposit so Collect reverts due to insufficient balance.

For any initialized contract with a positive MinSum, any actor that receives Ether via the fallback will have their balance correctly reflect the sent amount after a successful self-call Collect; the buggy version fails to credit the fallback deposit, causing Collect to revert due to insufficient balance.

After an initialized contract has a nonzero MinSum, an actor who deposits funds via the receive fallback, then withdraws a valid amount, will see their balance reduced accordingly; the mutant never credits the deposit, so Collect either reverts or the balance stays unchanged.

After Collect succeeds, the contract's ETH balance must have decreased by exactly the collected amount; the mutant never credits deposits, so either Collect reverts (no ETH moves) or if forced through a helper that provides ETH separately, the contract balance decreases despite no prior deposit being recorded.
For any deposit, the recorded balance must be at least msg.value; the bug can cause an overflow that wraps the balance to a value smaller than msg.value.

After any sequence of deposits and a subsequent collect call, the caller's balance must equal the initial balance plus deposits minus collects; the buggy version can cause an underflow during Collect that makes the resulting balance arbitrarily large instead of correctly reduced.
After any successful Deposit, balances[msg.sender] multiplied by any factor and added to any other balance must not be less than balances[msg.sender] due to unchecked overflow in the mutant.

After any Deposit, the sum over all balances must be at least the sum of all deposited amounts; the bug can cause an overflow in an individual balance without affecting the global sum, making the invariant vacuous in ways the original prevents.
